

# drawer

Cardtile renders the panel, trigger, and CSS, then loads this local-only coral
for keyboard focus handling. The snippet below shows the mount shape; the
renderer supplies the full panel structure and its registry has no `drawer`
channel.

<!-- coral metadata: start (generated by catalog-readme.mjs) -->
## drawer metadata

Adds keyboard and focus handling to a Cardtile-rendered drawer; its panel and CSS come from the renderer.

Author: `official`.

Host: `cardtile`. Cardtile-only renderer output, not a standalone copy-paste embed. Cardtile supplies page CSS and the coral script. Renderer emits DRAWER_CSS in a style element. An optional .dc-drawer-close inside a panel receives focus on open.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dynamic-coral` | enum | yes | — | Selects the drawer coral. Values: `drawer`. |
| `data-drawer-panel` | string | yes | — | Panel identifier; its id must equal this value and the opener URL hash. |
| `data-drawer` | string | no | — | Opener target panel id; remembers the opener to restore focus. |
| `data-back-url` | string | no | — | On an opener: an https link the opened back offers as a pill, so a card that both links out and has a back keeps its link. |
| `data-back-rel` | string | no | — | On an opener: rel for the data-back-url pill; defaults to noopener noreferrer. |
